args.title: Remember the last used export format in ExportButton
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change ExportButton to remember and restore the user's last export format selection instead of always initializing with the defaultFormat prop, so the export format selector does not reset to CSV every time the report is opened.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component does not currently remember the last used export format, instead always defaulting to 'csv'. The proposed change is to alter this behavior by storing and restoring the user's last format selection across page reloads, improving user experience by avoiding the need to reselect the format each time the report is opened.
